surface: Phase 9 Hardening — Live Demo chrome and fixtures

sentences.en: The exact rows behind the chart.
sentences.zh: 图表背后的精确数据行。

sentences.en: Six prepared research runs with performance and metadata columns.
sentences.zh: 六条准备好的研究记录，含表现与元数据列。

sentences.en: Shown inside a real table, which is the only context the component renders in.
sentences.zh: 放在真实表格里展示——这是该组件唯一能渲染的上下文。

sentences.en: The rows behind a surface, one control away, without pushing the page down.
sentences.zh: 数据行就在一层浮面之后，一个控件即可打开，且不会把页面撑长。

sentences.en: The list is controlled: it reports the complete new order and the caller owns it.
sentences.zh: 该列表是受控的：它回报完整的新顺序，状态由调用方持有。

sentences.en: Two panes, one value: the selected ids on the right are the whole state.
sentences.zh: 两个面板，一个值：右侧被选中的 id 就是全部状态。

sentences.en: One paragraph set in the four voices: heading, body, numeric and code.
sentences.zh: 一段文字，四种声线：标题、正文、数字与代码。
